explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/542, first question: if A ⊆ {1,…,n} has lcm(a,b) > n for all a ≠ b, is Σ_{a∈A} 1/a ≤ 31/30? (yes, Schinzel–Szekeres; sharp for {2,3,5}). The Lean statement: for all n and A with IsLcmFree n A (A ⊆ Icc 1 n, pairwise lcm > n), Σ 1/a ≤ 31/30 in ℝ. Including 1 ∈ A is harmless (1 can only appear alone, giving sum 1). Direct transcription; my brute-force check for n ≤ 60 (done for the only_two variant) found maximum sum 31/30. Faithful.
